rosterVerified.method: real chat call per id against the live account

liveMatrix.result: Live tool round-trip verified on @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fast, both non-streaming and streaming, once messageContentFormat normalization was applied; before it the follow-up turn was rejected with HTTP 400 (content sent as array/null). Of the three ids that failed, only two are actually gone: mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2 ('No such model') and qwen1.5-14b-chat-awq ('deprecated on 2025-10-01'). llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct is alive but gated behind a one-time Community License acceptance on the account, so it answers 403 and is left production with vision false rather than retired.
